profileLabel: Strongly left economics; rights-protecting; mildly institution-supporting (medium confidence)
summary: Batangas 2nd District representative with 148 principal-authored bills. Authored a P200 daily wage increase, a universal social pension, agricultural pension and social security, universal health care, senior discounts, extrajudicial killing as a heinous crime, compensation for unjust imprisonment, an anti-dynasty ban, a ban on concurrent family elective positions, Ombudsman enforcement powers and presidential authority over petroleum taxes.
caveat: Economic score stays at -2 because pro bono physician tax incentives pull slightly right. Conduct beyond bills was not reviewed.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored a P200 daily wage increase (-3), universal social pension and agricultural pension (-3), strengthened universal health care (-3), against pro bono physician tax incentives (+1).

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB01429, HB03981, HB01458, HB01919, HB01428 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

social.label: Insufficient evidence
social.rationale: Fewer than two adequately evidenced issues in the sources reviewed; left unscored.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: no scorable evidence in reviewed bills (retrieved 2026-11-01)

civil.label: Protective-leaning
civil.rationale: Authored classifying extrajudicial killing as a heinous crime (+3, police accountability) and increased compensation for victims of unjust imprisonment (+3, due process). Two related issues.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB01461, HB02337 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

democratic.label: Institution-supporting
democratic.rationale: Authored an anti-dynasty ban and family-position limits (+3) and Ombudsman anti-corruption enforcement power (+3), offset by presidential emergency authority over petroleum taxes (-2, executive power).

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB08389, HB07413, HB11413, HB08408 (retrieved 2026-11-01)
